sql: select case when split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXFEDMENTION','KXINX','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXRAIN','KXTRUMPSAY','KXWCMENTION') then 'WIN-series' else 'other' end grp, count(*) orders, sum(case when status in ('filled','partially_filled','settled') then quantity else 0 end) filled_ct, sum(case when status in ('filled','partially_filled','settled','canceled','cancelled','expired') then quantity else 0 end) resolved_ct, count(distinct market_ticker) markets, min(created_at)::date first_day from live_orders where strategy = 'Kmmsell10' and action = 'buy' group by 1 order by 1
